description: One line at session start naming this pack's skill, so it is found without relying on description matching.

args: The iOS expertise pack is enabled in this repository. Its `mobile-ios:ios` skill has reference notes on xcodebuild, signing and package failures, UIKit and Objective-C legacy code, Swift concurrency, Core Data and SwiftData migrations, testing, performance, and App Store requirements. The notes carry dated platform requirements and migration traps that general knowledge often gets wrong; the skill says which note matches a task.
